title: 71 - Charlie
summary: [[character:bob-replicant|Bob]] takes [[technology:charlie]] out onto [[location:delta-eridani-4|Eden]] and experiences the forest through the android's senses. [[character:archimedes]] recognizes him but spots three giveaways: an artificial smell, an uneven walk, and mirror-image fur markings. On the second trial, Archimedes approves of the changes and leads him into busy [[location:camelot]]. Some residents still travel between Camelot and [[location:caerleon]] despite the tension. At the family fire, Bob has the translator render his cover name as Robert. [[character:diana]] shows no sign of recognizing him, and her frailty reinforces his impression that Archimedes is aging slowly. When one of [[character:buster]]'s grandchildren runs into him, Bob answers playfully and the gathering relaxes.

introducing.name: Charlie
introducing.description: A Deltan look-alike android operated by [[character:bob-replicant|Bob]] as a physical presence on [[location:delta-eridani-4|Eden]]. It relays touch and smell, translates expressions into Deltan gestures, and displays a local map. Its fur markings and scent are designed to let it blend in.

updates.current_state: He has visited Camelot through [[technology:charlie]] under a Deltan cover name rendered as Robert. Diana showed no sign of recognizing him at the family hearth.
He helps Bob refine his android disguise and introduces him to the family. Bob sees him as a closer friend and suspects he is aging unusually slowly.

updates.state: The village is crowded, with residents gathered around both central and smaller fires. Some people still travel between it and [[location:caerleon]] despite the tension.
The settlement is growing and remains on tense terms with [[location:camelot]], though some people continue to move between the villages.

updates.current_state: Bob finds her visibly frail with age. She shows no sign of recognizing him in his Deltan disguise.
He has grandchildren and still keeps close to his father, while his siblings have established separate hearths.
